purpose: Synthetic native movement-key hash fixtures and source identity; no executable or assembly

semantics.character: signed native x86 char, expressed explicitly as i8
semantics.fold: original signed sum XOR arithmetic shift by ten XOR arithmetic shift by twenty
semantics.packet_key: checksum feed XOR admitted message ACK XOR native command hash

fixture_generation.method: Original immutable C algorithm evaluated by C++14 constexpr; generated constant-return assembly inspected without execution or saving
static_assertions: negative signed right shift is arithmetic
fixture_generation.constant_validation: Every fixture reduced to an immediate EAX return or zero EAX return, additionally cross-checked against signed-byte integer arithmetic

scope: Native-profile key semantics and synthetic packet evidence; session provenance and ordinary native peer interoperability remain separate
